# Muslimin e.V. — LLM-readable site index
# See https://llmstxt.org for the specification

# Muslimin e.V. is a Muslim women's association based in Berlin, Germany.
# Founded in 2011, it provides community programmes, advisory services,
# humanitarian aid fundraising (Yemen), and events for Muslim women and girls.

## Pages

- [Startseite](https://muslimin-ev.de/): Landing page with overview of the association
- [Über uns](https://muslimin-ev.de/ueber-uns): About the association, mission and history
- [Veranstaltungen](https://muslimin-ev.de/veranstaltungen): Events and community gatherings
- [Beratung](https://muslimin-ev.de/beratung): Advisory services and booking
- [Spenden](https://muslimin-ev.de/spenden): Donation page — Yemen humanitarian aid and Berlin programmes
- [Mitgliedschaft](https://muslimin-ev.de/mitgliedschaft): Membership information
- [Kontakt](https://muslimin-ev.de/kontakt): Contact form and details
